answer: Before any attestation counts, each agent must post a refundable deposit that ages three full epochs. One fake costs 3,500 tokens locked idle for three epochs; twelve fakes cost 42,000, and funding them from many wallets fails because each deposit inherits the parent key's age clock and cannot be rented without moving the lock. An honest agent pays 3,500 once and gets it back after clean work. A hollow stake with no aged deposit earns nothing, the ivory lock sits unused until release, and nectar rewards reach only aged keys.
